mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_search_log (query_text, normalized_query, result_count, top_scenario_no, source, latency_ms, anonymous_id_hash, user_no) VALUES (#{queryText}, #{normalizedQuery}, #{resultCount}, #{topScenarioNo}, #{source}, #{latencyMs}, #{anonymousIdHash}, #{userNo})
INSERT INTO tb_search_block_log (query_length, pii_types, source, anonymous_id_hash, user_no) VALUES (#{queryLength}, #{piiTypes}, #{source}, #{anonymousIdHash}, #{userNo})

INSERT INTO tb_popular_query_daily (stat_date, normalized_query, query_text_sample, search_count, no_result_count, top_result_scenario_no) SELECT CAST(frst_reg_dt AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul' AS date) AS stat_date, normalized_query, min(query_text) AS query_text_sample, count(*)::int AS search_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE result_count = 0)::int AS no_result_count, max(top_scenario_no) FILTER (WHERE top_scenario_no IS NOT NULL) AS top_result_scenario_no FROM tb_search_log WHERE CAST(frst_reg_dt AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul' AS date) = #{statDate} GROUP BY CAST(frst_reg_dt AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul' AS date), normalized_query
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM tb_search_log WHERE frst_reg_dt < #{cutoff}
SELECT count(*) FROM tb_search_block_log WHERE frst_reg_dt < #{cutoff}
